response.sql: WITH tot AS (SELECT SUM(articount) AS total FROM scanfeatures), unit AS (SELECT zoneref, SUM(articount) AS artifact_count FROM scanfeatures GROUP BY zoneref), sh AS (SELECT u.zoneref, u.artifact_count, (1.0 * u.artifact_count) / NULLIF(t.total, 0) AS share FROM unit u CROSS JOIN tot t), withavg AS (SELECT zoneref, artifact_count, share, AVG(share) OVER () AS avg_share FROM sh) SELECT zoneref AS site_code, artifact_count, share, share - avg_share AS share_minus_avg FROM withavg WHERE avg_share IS NOT NULL ORDER BY (share - avg_share) IS NULL, share - avg_share DESC LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: A site whose articount values are all NULL has a NULL site count (SUM of no values), so its share and difference are NULL and it sorts last; it stays in the share average only as ignored (NULL).
If the overall artifact total is 0, shares are treated as missing (division by zero avoided via NULLIF), so no rows are returned.
